notes_title: v2: what changed, and what to check
notes: Redone for screws into the 2x4's face only and the bike perpendicular with its tires on the pegboard. The arm comes out beside the wheel and a bar reaches sideways through the spokes; the rim sits on its rounded top about 53° round from the top of the wheel. There the rim's push goes through the hub, so the wheel hangs still and the tire is pulled flat onto the board. To hang: front tire on the board just right of the hook, lift about 4 cm, slide left onto the bar, lower. Five screws go through pegboard holes into the 2x4. Please check: (1) is the 2x4 flat behind the board (3.5 in face), and which hole rows are over it? (2) bike weight, wheel size, tire width, spoke count; (3) is left of the wheel the right side for the arm?
